facts.value: Certified copies of official documents from each secondary school, college, university or technical school attended must be sent. Records must include courses completed, grades or marks earned, and certificates or degrees awarded.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: One set of official transcripts from every college and university from which a bachelor's degree or higher was earned must be sent to ASU. If the school(s) cannot send them directly, they may be sent by the applicant if they meet specific requirements.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Original academic credentials issued by the registrar of the institution attended, verified photocopies by a responsible official of the institution, or certified photocopies by a recognized international educational organization are acceptable.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Photocopies certified by a notary public and scanned copies are not accepted in lieu of official academic documents.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: All international transcripts must be submitted in their original language accompanied by an official English translation done by a recognized authority.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Translations must be provided by the issuing university, an official translation service, the Ministry of Education, consulate, or embassy.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Applicants must write their application reference number on all documents and envelopes submitted to expedite processing.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA

facts.value: Graduate Admission Services, Arizona State University, 1150 East University Drive Building C, Room 226, Tempe, AZ 85281 for FedEx, DHL or UPS.
facts.programme_association: Applied Military and Veterans Studies - BA
